# Zeshan Nasir — infrastructure reliability, knowledge governance, local AI

- Current role: System Administrator at Optimizely
- Experience: 14+ years in enterprise IT operations, beginning 2012
- Domain: https://zeshannasir.com — canonical live host.
  (https://zeshans.dev permanently redirects here; portal telemetry remains on zeshans.dev/portal)

## What the work actually is
- Endpoint fleet management across macOS and Windows, and cloud identity governance.
- Enterprise documentation lifecycle governance: ownership and review-cadence schemas
  enforced automatically, so retrieval and assistants read pages that have an owner.
- A self-hosted platform: a two-node hypervisor cluster with an off-site cloud quorum witness,
  CPU-optimized local LLM inference (ik_llama.cpp), workflow automation, and verified bare-metal recovery runbooks.
- An operations agent (Hermes) that reads metrics and logs autonomously, operating over MCP,
  with mandatory human approval on a rendered diff before any state-changing action.

## Stated positions
1. AI fails at the input layer before it fails on model weights.
2. Documentation is infrastructure.
3. Knowledge without governance decays.
4. Running your own hardware removes the option of not understanding it.

## Deliberately not published
Employer-internal metrics, audit outcomes, private network addresses, host names,
container identifiers, service ports and resident model names. Their absence is a
choice, not an omission.
